title: SkyrimNet SexLab
tagline: LLM actions and prompts for SexLab scenes.
description:
Ships the SexLab actions, helper prompts, and character-bio / narration submodules used by SkyrimNet_SexLab. Requires `SkyrimNet_SexLab.esp`.

Plugin menu settings stay in `config/plugins/SkyrimNet_SexLab/` (`sexlab.*` keys). Change options in the SkyrimNet dashboard, not the in-game MCM. Decorators and Papyrus execute live in this mod's SKSE plugin and scripts, not in this content folder.

Scene JSON, animations, and the WebUI stay in this mod's own `SKSE/Plugins/SkyrimNet_SexLab/` folder, not in this plugin.
author: goodprovider
